comments.body:
@iqcreaturehero786 

This is the clearest photo of a Hook Bill I've seen on iNat thus far. Just look at that bill!

Aren't hookbills a critically endangered breed? Yeah the The Livestock Conservancy  considers them in critical state. Apparently at their lowest point there were only 15 in the world. If its still somewhere after all these years someone should catch it.
Yes, it's one of the most endangered breeds of Mallard. It's strange how it just ended up here!
